 Siti Nordiana Sapuwan was last seen near Block 577 Woodlands Drive 16 at about 8pm on Oct 22.
 PHOTO: SINGAPORE POLICE FORCE
 Clay Lim
 Published   Oct 23, 2026, 07:05 PM
 Updated   Oct 24, 2026, 10:43 AM
 Set as preferred source Listen Summarise Singapore police are appealing for help to find 24-year-old Siti Nordiana Binte Sapuwan, who was last seen near Block 577 Woodlands Drive 16 at about 8pm on Oct 22.
 She was wearing a black short sleeve T-shirt and black long pants when she went missing, according to the police statement on Oct 23.
 Anyone with information can call 1800-255-0000 or submit it online at www.police.gov.sg/i-witness; police said all information will be kept strictly confidential.

 SINGAPORE – A 24-year-old woman who was previously reported missing has been found, the police said in an update on Oct 24.
 Siti Nordiana Sapuwan was last seen near Block 577 Woodlands Drive 16 at about 8pm on Oct 22, the police said in an appeal for her whereabouts on Oct 23.
